scanner_c.notes: Sep 24 previous-24h scan across the US, China/HK, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Europe, biased toward AI/semiconductors, macro, rates, supply chains and identifiable corporate catalysts. Major claims prioritized Reuters and other high-quality reporting; overlapping summit and AI-financing angles were deduplicated.

items.event_title: SoftBank raises $11.1 billion in record high-yield corporate bond sale to fund OpenAI bet
items.news_summary: SoftBank raised $11.1 billion in dollar- and euro-denominated bonds, the largest high-yield corporate bond sale globally on record, as it funds its OpenAI investment and other AI bets.
items.investor_materiality: Very high: directly links AI capital spending to leverage, credit spreads and OpenAI financing.
items.selection_reason: Large, fresh and unusually concrete AI-financing catalyst with cross-asset implications.
items.video_angle: AI 烧钱进入债券时代：SoftBank 为什么敢一次借 111 亿美元押 OpenAI？

items.event_title: Historic AI buildout financing raises systemic-risk concerns
items.news_summary: A fresh Reuters report highlights research warning that the scale and financing structure of the U.S. AI infrastructure buildout could create broader financial-system risks.
items.investor_materiality: Very high for hyperscalers, data-center suppliers, utilities, credit markets and AI valuation assumptions.
items.selection_reason: Fresh systemic-risk framing around the market's dominant capital-expenditure theme.
items.youtube_query: AI data center debt systemic risk
items.video_angle: AI 最大风险可能不是估值，而是借债：数据中心融资会不会变成系统性风险？

items.event_title: Meta Muse reshapes perceived winners and losers across U.S. equities
items.news_summary: Reuters reports Meta's Muse personal AI agent has split stock-market fortunes as investors reassess internet intermediaries and transaction gateways.
items.investor_materiality: High: relevant to META and exposed travel, delivery, finance, media and commerce intermediaries.
items.selection_reason: Clear cross-sector equity reaction tied to a new AI-agent product rather than a generic AI narrative.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters, published within the scan window.
items.youtube_query: Meta META Muse AI agent stocks
items.video_angle: Meta 一个 AI Agent 为什么能同时重估旅游、金融、电商和外卖这些中间商？

items.event_title: US and China extend trade truce by two months ahead of Trump-Xi summit
items.news_summary: U.S. and Chinese officials agreed to extend the trade truce by two months to January 10 while working toward a broader deal; AI safety, tariffs and trade remain in focus.
items.investor_materiality: Very high for U.S. equities, semiconductors, industrials, agriculture, rare earths and China-exposed companies.
items.selection_reason: Concrete policy change immediately ahead of a major bilateral summit.
items.youtube_query: US China trade truce Trump Xi September 2026
items.video_angle: 中美休战又延两个月：真正影响美股的不是仪式，而是 AI、关税和稀土三条线。

items.event_title: US and Japan discuss Chinese yttrium curbs ahead of Trump-Xi meeting
items.news_summary: U.S. and Japanese officials and companies discussed supply bottlenecks caused by Chinese yttrium restrictions; the rare-earth metal is important to aerospace and chipmaking.
items.investor_materiality: High for semiconductor equipment, aerospace, defense and critical-mineral supply chains.
items.selection_reason: Specific under-covered critical-mineral bottleneck with direct chip and aerospace relevance.
items.youtube_query: China yttrium restrictions semiconductor Japan US
items.video_angle: 稀土战又多了一个冷门关键材料：钇为什么会卡住芯片和航空供应链？

items.event_title: BofA sees ECB rate hike in December as energy shock lifts inflation risk
items.news_summary: BofA Global Research now expects a 25-basis-point ECB hike in December as oil and gas prices keep euro-zone inflation pressure elevated.
items.investor_materiality: High for global rates, currencies, European equities and U.S. duration-sensitive assets.
items.selection_reason: Fresh shift in a major-bank rate call driven by a measurable energy shock.
items.youtube_query: ECB December rate hike energy inflation BofA
items.video_angle: 欧洲又要加息？油气价格正在把全球降息逻辑重新打乱。

items.event_title: Eurozone business activity posts surprise three-year-high expansion despite energy shock
items.news_summary: September surveys showed euro-zone business activity expanding at the fastest pace in more than three years even as energy costs rose, strengthening expectations for further ECB tightening.
items.investor_materiality: High for global growth, rates, EUR and multinational earnings assumptions.
items.selection_reason: Material macro surprise that changes the growth-versus-inflation policy mix.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters citing S&P Global PMI surveys.
items.video_angle: 能源冲击下欧洲经济反而三年最强：这为什么可能逼 ECB 继续加息？

items.entity: US equity market / rates and oil
items.event_title: Wall Street falls as oil prices and Treasury yields rise
items.news_summary: U.S. equities ended lower as rising oil prices and Treasury yields pressured valuations, with Alphabet and Amazon among the drags.
items.investor_materiality: High for SPY/QQQ and duration-sensitive megacap technology.
items.selection_reason: Clean market-level catalyst connecting oil, yields and megacap valuation pressure.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters market wrap within the previous 24 hours.
items.youtube_query: SPY QQQ oil Treasury yields September 23 2026
items.video_angle: 油价和美债收益率一起涨，为什么最先压的是 Google、Amazon 这些长久期科技股？

items.event_title: US farmers seek Chinese purchase commitments as Trump and Xi discuss trade
items.news_summary: Soybeans, sorghum and other U.S. farm products are high on the summit agenda alongside rare earths and AI, with farmers seeking stronger Chinese purchase commitments and tariff relief.
items.investor_materiality: Medium-high for agricultural commodities, machinery, fertilizers and trade-sensitive U.S. equities.
items.selection_reason: Specific sector-level transmission channel from the day's highest-profile trade catalyst.
items.youtube_query: Trump Xi China US soybean farm purchases
items.video_angle: 中美峰会不只看芯片：大豆采购为什么会直接影响农业股、化肥和机械链？

items.event_title: Meta tests human concierge behind Muse phone-calling feature
items.news_summary: Reuters reported Meta has tested human contractors quietly handling some phone calls placed through Muse, adding an execution-cost and scalability wrinkle to the personal AI-agent story.
items.investor_materiality: Medium-high: relevant to META's AI-agent economics, automation claims and scaling costs.
items.selection_reason: Concrete operational detail that challenges the pure-software economics assumed for AI agents.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters exclusive based on internal company posts; surfaced within current scan window.
